Chhath Puja 2026:chhath mahaparv ki shuruaat kaddu-bhat se hi kyon hoti hai?| Bihar Culture| Nahay Khay| N18V
Aaj yani 13 navanbar ko chhath mahaparv ki shuruaat nahay-khay ke sath huee hai. subah se hi vrati snan aur puja-path men jute hain. gharon men saph-saphaee ke sath chhath ke vishesh prasad kaddu-bhat ko taiyar kiya ja raha hai. lekin kya aapne kabhi socha hai ki chhath ki shuruaat kaddu-bhat se hi kyon hoti hai? aakhir nahay-khay ke din jamin par baithkar bhojan karne ki paranpra kyon hai? is din sendha namak aur shuddh ghi ka istemal kyon kiya jata hai?
